question: What is the full form of CLI in Computer terminology?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Command Line Interface.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The command line interface (CLI) is a** text-based interface** that allows users to** respond to visual prompts** by putting **single commands** into the interface and **receiving a response** in the same manner.
 
• The command line interface (CLI) is not the same as the** graphical user interface (GUI) **used in today's operating systems.
 
• The** teletypewriter machine **was the first to use CLI. Batched processing was used in this system.
 
• CLI, batch processing, and GUI are all available in one interface on modern systems.
 
• The **command prompt**, which is a sequence of characters used in the user interface, or shell, is another component of CLI. The command prompt informs users that the **CLI is ready** to take commands.
 
• **MS-DOS** is the best example of CLI.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Graphical user interface (GUI)**__

 
 
• A graphical user interface (GUI) is a** user interface** that uses **icons, menus, and other visual indicators** or representations to allow users to **interact with electronic devices** such as computers and smartphones (graphics).
 
• Unlike text-based interfaces, where data and commands are purely in text, GUIs** graphically show information** and corresponding user controls.
 
• A **pointing device**, such as a **mouse, trackball, stylus, or a finger** on a touch screen, is used to manipulate GUI representations.
